pack.name: Zero Trust Architecture
pack.description: Continuous verification, identity perimeter, and micro-segmentation themes. Not a ZTA maturity certification.

rules.title: All resources treated as internet-facing
rules.description: Architecture must assume no implicit trust based on network location — every access decision verified explicitly.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document verify-explicitly principle in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Identity as primary perimeter
rules.description: Access control must center on user and workload identity — not VPN or datacenter perimeter alone.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag identity-centric access on services[].Tags; document IdP integration in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Least-privilege access enforced
rules.description: Roles, scopes, and API permissions must document minimum necessary access with periodic rightsizing.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture least-privilege policy in governance.PolicyConstraints; align RBAC with azureExtractor assignments.

rules.title: Assume breach detection posture
rules.description: Architecture must document continuous monitoring, deception, or anomaly detection — not prevention-only design.
rules.remediationGuidance: List detection sources in governance.RequiredControls and security services[].Tags.

rules.title: Device health and compliance signals
rules.description: Access decisions should incorporate device posture (MDM compliance, managed device) where risk warrants.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document device compliance conditions in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Continuous authentication and step-up
rules.description: High-risk actions must document step-up authentication or continuous access evaluation — not single login at session start.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe step-up triggers in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags for admin and data-export APIs.

rules.title: Micro-segmentation for workloads
rules.description: East-west traffic between services must document segmentation (NSGs, service mesh, private link) with default deny.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map micro-segments in metadata.ChangeDescription; align subnet and NSG posture with azureExtractor.

rules.title: Encrypted communications everywhere
rules.description: All service-to-service and user-to-service paths must document TLS or mTLS — no trusted-zone plaintext exceptions without approval.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document TLS/mTLS in governance.PolicyConstraints; map encrypted edges on relationships[].

rules.title: Policy decision point documented
rules.description: Architecture must identify where access policy is evaluated (Entra CA, API gateway, service mesh PDP) per resource type.
rules.remediationGuidance: List PDP components in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Policy enforcement point at data path
rules.description: Enforcement (PEP) must sit inline with data access — not solely at network edge for internal APIs.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document PEP placement on API gateways and data services in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Software-defined perimeter for admin access
rules.description: Administrative access should use JIT, PIM, or brokered access — not standing VPN to management networks.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record JIT/PIM patterns in governance.RequiredControls and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Workload identity for service-to-service auth
rules.description: Services must use managed identity, workload identity federation, or mTLS — not long-lived shared secrets in configuration.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag workload-identity usage on services[].Tags; document secret elimination in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Data-centric protection (classification-driven)
rules.description: Protection controls must follow data classification — encryption, masking, and access scoped to sensitivity labels.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align classification tags on datastores[].Tags with governance.ComplianceTags and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Analytics for user and entity behavior
rules.description: UEBA or equivalent anomaly detection should be documented for identity and data-access patterns.
rules.remediationGuidance: List UEBA integration in governance.RequiredControls and security monitoring services[].Tags.

rules.title: Automated threat response integration
rules.description: SOAR or automated playbooks must document identity disable, session revoke, and network isolation actions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe automated response hooks in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Third-party access zero-trust patterns
rules.description: Partner and vendor access must use federated identity, scoped tokens, and time-bound grants — not shared VPN accounts.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document B2B access patterns in governance.PolicyConstraints and external services[] on relationships[].

rules.title: Legacy application ZTNA wrapper
rules.description: Legacy apps without native ZTA support must document application proxy or ZTNA gateway with session inspection.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag legacy-app proxy services in services[].Tags; describe wrapper architecture in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: API gateway as zero-trust enforcement
rules.description: North-south and east-west APIs should route through gateways with authn, authz, rate limits, and WAF.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document API gateway policy in governance.RequiredControls; tag gateway-protected services.

rules.title: Segmentation for IoT and OT adjacency
rules.description: If IoT/OT systems connect, architecture must document isolation from corporate and data tiers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe IoT/OT zones in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Logging of all access decisions
rules.description: Policy allow/deny decisions and identity assertions must feed centralized logging for investigation.
rules.remediationGuidance: List authz decision logs in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor diagnostic settings.

rules.title: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators
rules.description: Privileged users must document phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2, certificate-based) where available.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record phishing-resistant MFA in governance.RequiredControls and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Session lifetime and re-authentication
rules.description: Session tokens must document maximum lifetime, idle timeout, and refresh rotation policies.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture session policy in governance.PolicyConstraints and services[].Tags for user-facing apps.

rules.title: Data loss prevention on egress paths
rules.description: Outbound flows carrying sensitive data must document DLP inspection or equivalent egress controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag DLP-enforced egress in services[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Zero trust for CI/CD pipelines
rules.description: Build and deploy pipelines must document signed commits, OIDC federation, and least-privilege deployment identities.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe pipeline identity in governance.RequiredControls; tag CI/CD services with zt-pipeline in services[].Tags.

rules.title: Multi-cloud identity federation
rules.description: Cross-cloud workloads must document centralized IdP and consistent policy — not siloed local accounts per cloud.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document federation architecture in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Risk-based adaptive access
rules.description: Conditional Access or equivalent must incorporate sign-in risk, location, and device signals for adaptive decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture adaptive access policy in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Zero trust maturity roadmap referenced
rules.description: Architecture should state current ZTA maturity target and phased rollout — not claim full ZTA without evidence.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note maturity phase in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Guest and external collaboration zero trust
rules.description: External collaboration (Teams, SharePoint, B2B) must document scoped sharing and expiration policies.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document external sharing controls in governance.PolicyConstraints when M365 collaboration is in scope.
